findings.passage: Senate Bill 204 : relating to absentee voting uniformity, closing voter ID loopholes, and clarifying the online voter registration and absentee ballot request process, would ensure voter ID laws are followed for absentee voting.
findings.note: Feyen's e-update describes SB 204, vetoed by the governor, as ensuring voter ID laws are followed for absentee voting. The same update lists SB 203 on secure delivery of absentee ballots.

findings.passage: Despite this, I am still committed to fighting to secure transparency in our elections, and ensuring our election system makes it easy to vote and hard to cheat.
findings.note: E-update on a package of election bills (including SB 204 and others); states his commitment on election security. Does not itself discuss ID.

findings.passage: Our elections going forward will be much safer and more secure, thanks to you.
findings.note: E-update titled April 3rd Update: Securing Our Elections, after voters approved two constitutional amendments on the ballot; he says more election amendments are coming in August and November. Does not mention ID.

findings.passage: Look out for two more opportunities (one on your ballot in August and one in November) to help further secure our elections.
findings.note: Same e-update; points to further ballot questions on election security.
